class.description: SplineTweenResourceInspector (`GeometryEditorInspectorBase`) Mounts `SplineTweenerControl` in the Godot Inspector whenever a `SplineTweenResource` or `SplineTweener` node is inspected. Part of IdeamSplines (2D/3D Bezier/Catmull-Rom splines and scene-space spline editing).
